comments.author: @MyPlanetUnseen
comments.text: Lake Powell always offers a sharp contrast. The juxtaposition of that 50-degree water winding through the narrow canyons against the 100-degree summer heat of the sandstone is an environment you truly have to feel in person to understand.

replies.author: @EXPLOREHORIZONS66
replies.text: You described that contrast perfectly; it’s an environment that really is unlike anything else on Earth!

comments.author: @unchartedplanettv
comments.text: This documentary is a lovely reminder that our planet still conceals countless quiet wonders, evolving peacefully far beyond our busy tourist trails

replies.author: @EXPLOREHORIZONS66
replies.text: I’m so glad you enjoyed the journey and appreciate the hidden beauty found off the beaten path!
